lead.label: Labour
lead.headline: New garment wages to start in December
lead.summary: Owners and workers on the new wage board agreed the timing at its first meeting. The amount is still open, with workers asking for Tk 30,000 a month.

alsoToday.headline: Climate adaptation needs longer loans and guarantees to draw private money
alsoToday.summary: The National Adaptation Plan puts the need at $230 billion by 2050.

special.label: Special report · Funding intelligence
special.headline: Record pledges, shrinking NGOs: who gets Bangladesh's aid money
special.summary: Foreign grants to NGOs are at a seven-year high, yet about 2,200 small NGOs face cuts. Our analysis shows the money is reaching fewer, larger organisations.
